description: World - Climate Watch is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate", published or maintained by Climate Watch. 2019. Washington, D.C.: World Resources Institute. (World Resources Institute). Climate Watch is an online platform that provides policymakers, researchers, media and other stakeholders with the open climate data, visualizations and resources they need to gather insights on national and global progress on climate change. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 12 files in ZIP. The portal files it under Climate. The portal gives 2019 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
